summary: Mark Twain NF lookout 3 miles south of Chadwick, Christian County: erected spring 1936, on a 1955 USGS map; no source found on its current status.

events.note: Construction began March 1936 on the fourth tower in the Pondfork forest unit (The Douglas County Herald, March 12, 1936); a March 1937 paper (Christian County Republican) says it was erected the spring before
April 9, 1936 (The Douglas County Herald): a CCC camp was set up at the tower for the workers building it (construction, not lookout staffing)
Telephone line connecting the tower to the Swan tower completed December 1936 (reported March 25, 1937)
Saunders Lookout Tower listed among the features of a USGS map portraying 1955, per the map seller's description

notes_for_editor: Status and access are unknown: no source found after two searches and the page reads. The only primary-period sources are 1936-37 newspaper items transcribed on the Central US Lookouts page. The Pastmaps item is a print seller's description of a USGS map, so it shows the tower existed by 1955 and nothing later. The April 1936 CCC camp was for construction, so it is not logged as staffing. Checked and not mentioning Saunders: MDC Shooting the Smoke article (2022), trailsfortwo.com lookout towers page. Not reachable: missourilife.com (403), anyplaceamerica.com directory (403). Brief status 'unknown' and agency 'Mark Twain National Forest' are unchanged. Suggested follow-up: Mark Twain NF district office or Bob Frakes's lookout book for the tower's fate. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the Christian County heading, the March 12 1936, April 9 1936 and March 25 1937 item dates, the newspaper names and the USGS publisher were confirmed on the source pages and are now in the evidence list.
